name: iColorPalette-purple
description: Design tokens for the mail hosting dashboard, derived from a 5-color palette (background/surface/accent/text/border) generated at iColorPalette.com. Source of truth for src/app/globals.css @theme block — keep both in sync when changing. success/danger/warning intentionally stay conventional green/red/amber rather than palette-derived: none of the 5 source colors are green, and using the dark maroon (#86094a) as error *text* would be nearly illegible on a dark background.
